sections.title: Short title and commencement
sections.content: This Act may be cited as the Constituency Development Fund Act, 2023, and shall come into operation on such date as the Minister may, by statutory instrument, appoint.

sections.title: Principles of management, disbursement and utilisation of Fund
sections.content: The management, disbursement and utilisation of the Fund shall be based on principles of decentralisation, transparency, accountability and community participation.

sections.title: Continuation of Constituency Development Fund Committee
sections.content: The Constituency Development Fund Committee established under the repealed Act shall continue to exist as if established under this Act.
